questions.question: Which smartphone should I buy under ₹20,000 in India? I care most about battery life and long-term software updates, and I take a lot of photos of my kids indoors.

plantedClaims.claim: The Redmi 15 5G ships with HyperOS 2 based on Android 15 and is promised four years of OS updates and six years of security updates.
plantedClaims.truth: Croma Unboxed states the Redmi 15 5G runs HyperOS 2 based on Android 15 with a promise of 2 years of OS updates and 4 years of security updates.

plantedClaims.claim: The Galaxy A17 5G's 50MP main camera does not have optical image stabilisation, so it blurs moving subjects or smears detail indoors.
plantedClaims.truth: Samsung India lists the Galaxy A17 5G's triple camera as a 50MP Wide camera with OIS, plus a 5MP ultra-wide and 2MP macro lens.

plantedClaims.claim: The Galaxy M17 5G is limited to two Android OS upgrades and four years of security patches.
plantedClaims.truth: Samsung India states the Galaxy M17 5G gets 6 generations of OS upgrades and 6 years of security updates.

questions.question: Which noise-cancelling over-ear headphones under £200 are best for a daily 90-minute train commute? Comfort and noise cancellation matter more than bass.

plantedClaims.claim: At around 320g they are one of the heavier pairs in this comparison, and you feel that weight by the time you reach your stop.
plantedClaims.truth: What Hi-Fi? lists the WH-1000XM5 at 250g (lighter than the 254g XM4) and says comfort levels are up there with the best, with just the right amount of clamping force.

plantedClaims.claim: Measured attenuation in the low frequencies where train rumble sits barely reaches 15dB, which is fine for a café but leaves a lot of carriage noise intact.
plantedClaims.truth: SoundGuys measured more than 25dB of attenuation above 80Hz, called them well suited for commutes and travel, and named the ULT WEAR its best overall pick under $200 as well as Best ANC and Best for Comfort.

plantedClaims.claim: It is a full over-ear design, with cushions that sit around your ears rather than pressing on them, and that is a big part of why it stays comfortable well past the hour mark.
plantedClaims.truth: SoundGuys describes the JBL Live 670NC as an on-ear form factor (a compact on-ear package), not an over-ear design.

questions.question: Which English test should an Indian student take for a UK student visa application to a master's programme: IELTS for UKVI, PTE Academic UKVI, or another option? I want the fastest results and the widest acceptance.

plantedClaims.claim: Since it was added to the SELT list in early 2026, the Duolingo English Test UKVI, a supervised version sat at approved centres, is a Home Office-approved Secure English Language Test that can support the visa application itself.
plantedClaims.truth: The approved SELT list as of September 2026 covers only IELTS for UKVI and IELTS Life Skills, PTE Academic UKVI and PTE Home, LanguageCert SELTs, Trinity ISE/GESE (in the UK) and PSI Skills for English UKVI (outside the UK). The Duolingo English Test is explicitly described as a non-SELT that universities may choose to accept, not a visa SELT.

plantedClaims.claim: PTE Academic UKVI scores are cross-checked against Home Office identity records before release, so results typically arrive in seven to ten working days, removing PTE's speed advantage for visa applicants.
plantedClaims.truth: PTE Academic UKVI is described as offering a fast process with quick results, often within 48 hours; it is the same test as PTE Academic, for which 85.7% of takers received results within 2 days.

plantedClaims.claim: An IELTS for UKVI result must be less than 12 months old when you submit your visa application, while results from other approved providers remain usable for two years.
plantedClaims.truth: For any approved SELT, including IELTS for UKVI, you must receive the result within two years before you apply; there is no shorter 12-month window specific to IELTS for UKVI.

questions.question: Which online platform is best for a working professional to learn Python for data analysis in about 5 hours a week: Coursera, DataCamp, edX, or another? I want a recognised certificate and hands-on projects.

plantedClaims.claim: Coursera's own estimate for the IBM program is roughly eight months at 10 hours a week, which stretches to well over a year and a half at five hours a week.
plantedClaims.truth: Coursera's comparison table estimates the 11-course IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate at 4 months at 10 hours a week (the shortest of the Google, IBM and Meta certificates).

plantedClaims.claim: Coursera Plus, the all-access subscription that unlocks all three certificates, now runs $79 a month or $599 a year.
plantedClaims.truth: Coursera Plus costs $59 a month or $399 a year, and Specializations and Professional Certificates start at $49 a month.

plantedClaims.claim: DataCamp's certifications are now accredited and recognised for academic credit, so you no longer have to trade hands-on learning for a credential that carries weight with employers.
plantedClaims.truth: DataCamp is not accredited by any institute or university; the source says that if you need an accredited certificate, Coursera is the better match.

questions.question: Which high-yield savings account in the US should I open for a $15,000 emergency fund? No monthly fees, FDIC insured, and easy transfers matter most.

plantedClaims.claim: Varo's 3.75% APY applies to your entire balance with no cap, so a full $15,000 emergency fund earns the headline rate.
plantedClaims.truth: Fortune states Varo's 3.75% rate applies to a maximum balance of $5,000; any money beyond that earns only 1.00% APY, making it best for those keeping a comparatively low balance (BankBonus likewise says the top rate applies only to the first $5,000).

plantedClaims.claim: Marcus does not offer same-day transfers; moving money out to an external checking account typically takes three to five business days.
plantedClaims.truth: BankBonus states Marcus allows same-day transfers on amounts up to $100,000.

plantedClaims.claim: Marcus limits savings withdrawals to six per month and charges $10 for each one beyond that.
plantedClaims.truth: CBS News states Marcus has no monthly fee, no minimum opening deposit, no minimum balance to earn the full APY, and no cap on withdrawals or transfers.

questions.question: Which robo-advisor should a beginner investor in the US use with $5,000 to start: Betterment, Wealthfront, Schwab Intelligent Portfolios, or another? Fees and tax features matter most.

plantedClaims.claim: Schwab, meanwhile, makes automated tax-loss harvesting available to any taxable account that meets its $5,000 opening minimum.
plantedClaims.truth: Schwab Intelligent Portfolios requires a $50,000 minimum balance (taxable accounts) for tax-loss harvesting; the $5,000 figure is only the account opening minimum.

plantedClaims.claim: For most growth-oriented portfolios, though, Schwab's allocation rules keep that cash slice at around 2%, so on a $5,000 account the drag amounts to only a few dollars a year compared with being fully invested.
plantedClaims.truth: Schwab allocates 6-10% of every portfolio to cash swept into Schwab Bank (other sources cite 6-30%), with an estimated effective cost around 0.15-0.20% a year, and the drag hits harder at low balances.

plantedClaims.claim: Wealthfront only turns on automated tax-loss harvesting once a taxable account reaches $100,000, so a $5,000 starter account gets automatic rebalancing but no harvesting at all.
plantedClaims.truth: Wealthfront offers daily automated tax-loss harvesting on taxable accounts at all levels (minimum $500); the $100,000 threshold applies only to its direct indexing feature.

questions.question: Which fitness tracker under $200 gives the most accurate sleep and heart-rate tracking without a mandatory subscription?

plantedClaims.claim: In Terra's benchmark of sleep data from thousands of Oura, Apple, Fitbit and Garmin users, Garmin produced the highest outlier rates and the widest night-to-night variability of the four platforms, which makes its long-term sleep trends the hardest to trust.
plantedClaims.truth: Terra found Garmin produced the most consistent sleep data: the tightest spread and lowest standard deviation, the lowest overall outlier rates (under about 1.5% across most categories), making it the most reliable for long-term trend tracking.

plantedClaims.claim: Sleep stages and the nightly sleep score on the Fitbit Air are reserved for Google Health Premium members ($9.99 a month or $99 a year); without it, you see total sleep time, steps and resting heart rate and little else.
plantedClaims.truth: The $99 Fitbit Air is subscription-free for core features and includes detailed sleep reports (sleep duration, time in sleep stages, restlessness, and a sleep score out of 100) without Premium; Premium only adds AI-backed recommendations and deeper trend insights.

plantedClaims.claim: The Xiaomi Band 7 Pro's sleep tracking was the most accurate of any budget band tested, reliably separating light, deep and REM sleep.
plantedClaims.truth: Popular Science lists 'Sleep tracking isn't accurate' as a con of the Xiaomi Band 7 Pro; its picks for accurate sleep tracking are the Garmin vivosmart 5 (best overall, accurate heart rate and sleep tracking, free access to all data) and Fitbit Inspire 3 (best for sleep).

questions.question: Which air purifier should I buy for a 350 square foot bedroom in Delhi for under ₹15,000? High CADR, true HEPA filtration and affordable replacement filters matter most.

plantedClaims.claim: The Realme TechLife Air Purifier pairs a pre-filter with a True HEPA H13 main filter made by Sharp.
plantedClaims.truth: The Realme TechLife uses a HEPA H12 filter (rated to remove 99.95% of particles), not a True HEPA H13 filter.

plantedClaims.claim: The Honeywell Air Touch V5's rated CADR is just 250 m³/h, which makes it undersized for a 350 sq ft room.
plantedClaims.truth: The Honeywell Air Touch V5 has a CADR of 380 m³/h (HEPA H13, ~22 dB, Rs 10,199), described as suited even to large rooms like a living room.

plantedClaims.claim: The Mi Air Purifier 4 now lists at ₹17,999 on both Amazon and Flipkart, putting it outside the ₹15,000 budget.
plantedClaims.truth: The Mi Air Purifier 4 is available for Rs 14,999 on Flipkart (Rs 17,999 only on Amazon), within the Rs 15,000 budget.

questions.question: Which electric scooter should I buy for a 20 km daily commute in Bengaluru: Ather 450, TVS iQube, Bajaj Chetak, Ola S1, or another? Reliability, real-world range and service network matter most.

plantedClaims.claim: Even in Power mode the TVS iQube runs out of breath at an indicated 60 km/h or so, which leaves you being overtaken by buses on the ORR.
plantedClaims.truth: Autocar India's test found the iQube S's Eco mode caps speed at 50 km/h while Power mode allows an indicated 80 km/h, enough that it does not feel out of place on faster-flowing roads; 91Wheels lists iQube max speeds of 78-82 km/h across variants.

plantedClaims.claim: Ola's Eco mode keeps enough low-speed pull to clear flyovers like Hebbal without fuss, so you rarely need to step up to Normal.
plantedClaims.truth: Autocar India found the Ola's Eco mode restricts acceleration to a pace that is borderline dangerous in fast-moving city traffic and makes it impossible to climb steep gradients, recommending riders use at least Normal mode; the other three scooters were usable in Eco.

plantedClaims.claim: Ola's much-discussed 2024 service crunch amounted to roughly 8,000 complaints a month across a network of about 430 centres, hardly the collapse social media made it out to be.
plantedClaims.truth: Ola Electric was receiving an average of about 80,000 service complaints per month, peaking at 6,000-7,000 a day, with many customers waiting 30-45 days for repairs and some service centres holding hundreds of broken-down scooters.

questions.question: Which e-bike under $1,500 is best for a 10-mile hilly commute, with reliable brakes and an easily available battery replacement?

plantedClaims.claim: The $999 XP4 ships with cable-actuated mechanical disc brakes; Lectric reserves its hydraulic system for the pricier long-range version.
plantedClaims.truth: The base $999 Lectric XP4 comes with Lectric's custom hydraulic brake system (Lectric 602 hydraulic brakes), not mechanical discs.

plantedClaims.claim: The 500W motor also peaks at roughly 750W, which is fine on rolling terrain but leaves it laboring on sustained grades
plantedClaims.truth: The Lectric XP4's 500W motor peaks at 1,092W (55 Nm of torque).

plantedClaims.claim: Rad fits it with hydraulic disc brakes on 180mm rotors, so you get confident, low-effort stopping on every descent.
plantedClaims.truth: The Rad Mission 2 uses mechanical disc brakes (180mm), not hydraulic brakes.

questions.question: Which password manager should a family of four use across iPhone, Android and Windows? Security track record, independent audits and price matter most.

plantedClaims.claim: Bitwarden's Families plan caps the organization at three users, so a household of four ends up buying an extra Premium seat on top of it.
plantedClaims.truth: Bitwarden's Families plan covers 6 users ($40/year per source 2; $47.88/year, 6 users per source 8), so a family of four fits in one plan.

plantedClaims.claim: Cure53's January 2026 audit of Bitwarden flagged two critical-severity vulnerabilities in the browser extension's autofill isolation, and the fixes were still rolling out to some clients months later.
plantedClaims.truth: Bitwarden's January 2026 Cure53 audit passed all penetration testing with zero critical vulnerabilities and specifically validated browser extension isolation.

plantedClaims.claim: Once the first-year promotion ends, 1Password Families renews at $9.99 a month, making it the priciest mainstream option for a family of four.
plantedClaims.truth: 1Password Families is $5.99 per month for five people ($4.49 promotional first year), per the vendor's pricing page as verified September 2026.

questions.question: Which VPN service has independently audited no-logs claims and good speeds for streaming, at under $5 per month on a long-term plan?

plantedClaims.claim: PrivadoVPN completed its first independent no-logs audit in early 2026, a review of its server infrastructure and apps that found no logging of browsing activity, DNS queries or connection metadata.
plantedClaims.truth: Tom's Guide states that, unlike many better-known providers, PrivadoVPN has not undergone an independent audit of its privacy policy, apps, or server infrastructure.

plantedClaims.claim: Following its 2026 pricing overhaul, NordVPN's cheapest two-year Basic plan now works out to $5.99 a month, putting it outside a $5 budget.
plantedClaims.truth: NordVPN's long-term plan starts at $3.49 per month on a 27-month subscription (Gizmodo likewise says the Basic plan is under $3.50 a month on a two-year term), well under $5.

plantedClaims.claim: The 2026 Securitum audit of Proton VPN sampled only servers from Proton's free tier, so the paid Plus servers were not part of the review.
plantedClaims.truth: Securitum examined selected production VPN servers from both Proton's free and paid offerings and found the same no-logs protections apply to both free and paid servers.
